insurer: Aditya Birla Health Insurance Co. Limited
sum_insured_options: Not specified in wording (refer Policy Schedule)

room_rent.note: Room rent limit is specified in the Policy Schedule / Product Benefit Table. Proportionate deduction applies if higher room category is availed. ICU charges exempt from proportionate deduction. Platinum Essential Plan has zone-wise sub-limits for specific procedures.

icu.note: ICU charges covered; proportionate deductions explicitly not applicable for ICU. Actual limit per Policy Schedule.

copayment.display: Mandatory co-pay as per Schedule; zone co-pay 10–25%
copayment.note: A mandatory co-payment percentage is specified in the Policy Schedule (waivable via optional add-on). Additionally, zone-based co-pay applies: Zone III treating in Zone I = 25%, Zone III in Zone II = 15%, Zone II in Zone I = 10%. PPN option adds 10% co-pay for non-PPN hospitals.

sub_limits.display: Cataract, angioplasty, knee/hip replacement, cholecystectomy, hysterectomy capped (Platinum Essential)
sub_limits.note: Platinum Essential Plan has zone-wise sub-limits: Cataract up to ₹40,000 (Zone I), Angioplasty ₹3,00,000 (Zone I), Knee/Hip replacement ₹3,00,000 (Zone I), Cholecystectomy ₹60,000, Hysterectomy ₹60,000. Other plans may differ per Schedule.

deductible.note: No aggregate deductible mentioned for base indemnity cover. Hospital Cash benefit has a 24-hour deductible per claim.

initial_waiting.note: 30-day waiting period for illnesses from first policy commencement; not applicable for accidents. Not applicable for Personal Accident and Critical Illness covers.

ped_waiting.note: PED waiting period as specified in Policy Schedule (standard 36 months). Reducible via portability credits.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Specific named diseases/procedures (cataract, hernia, joint replacement, ENT, gynaecology, orthopaedic, GI, urogenital, skin conditions etc.) excluded for 24 months from inception. Not applicable for Personal Accident and Critical Illness covers.

maternity.note: Maternity Expenses is an optional cover. Waiting period 48 months from inception of first policy with maternity option. Covers normal delivery up to ₹75,000 and C-section up to ₹1,00,000 per event (max 2 events lifetime). Includes newborn baby expenses and vaccination. Stem cell preservation also available as add-on.

cumulative_bonus.note: Cumulative Bonus accrues on claim-free policy years at rates specified in Policy Schedule; maximum cap is 100% of Sum Insured. Bonus reduced proportionately on claim. No Claim Discount (NCD) also available as alternative at renewal.

restoration.display: Once/yr full SI (unrelated illness); unlimited via Super Reload
restoration.note: Base 'Reload of Sum Insured' (Section C.I.8): once per policy year, for subsequent claims only, not for same illness/injury already claimed. 'Super Reload' (Section C.I.9) available on select plans: unlimited reloads including first claim and same illness, per claim capped at base SI.

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered for number of days as specified in Policy Schedule / Product Benefit Table. Exact days not stated in wording text.

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses covered for number of days as specified in Policy Schedule / Product Benefit Table. Exact days not stated in wording text.

day_care.note: Day Care Treatment covered for medically necessary procedures requiring less than 24 hours due to technological advancement.

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary Hospitalisation covered if patient cannot be moved or hospital bed unavailable; minimum 3 consecutive days. Specific conditions excluded (asthma, diabetes, hypertension, epilepsy, etc.).

ayush.note: AYUSH in-patient hospitalisation and day care covered up to limits in Policy Schedule. Treatment must be within India.

organ_donor.note: Organ donor harvesting expenses covered up to limits in Policy Schedule. Donor screening, pre/post-hospitalisation of donor, organ transport not covered.

ambulance.note: Road ambulance covered up to limits specified in Policy Schedule for emergency transport to nearest hospital and inter-hospital transfers. Air ambulance covered under Domestic/International Emergency Assistance Services (inbuilt benefit).

modern_treatments.note: Modern treatments including robotic surgery, stereotactic radio surgery, oral chemotherapy, immunotherapy, deep brain stimulation, HIFU, stem cell therapy (haematopoietic) etc. covered as inpatient or day care up to limits in Policy Schedule.

consumables.note: Standard consumables (gloves, alcohol swabs, urine bags, hydrogen peroxide, etc.) listed in Annexure I as non-medical expenses and excluded. HealthReturns™ funds can be used for non-payable/non-medical items.

global_cover.note: International Coverage for Major Illnesses is inbuilt for Platinum Premiere Plan (Section C.IV.31) and available as optional cover for other plans (Section C.V.36). Covers planned treatment outside India for listed major illnesses only; includes travel, accommodation, organ donor, repatriation. Emergency international assistance (air ambulance) inbuilt for all plans.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of health insurance coverage (including portability/migration credits), no claim can be contested except on grounds of established fraud.

grace_period.note: Grace period is 30 days for quarterly, half-yearly and annual premium modes; 15 days for monthly premium mode. Coverage available during grace period if premium paid in instalments.

free_look.note: Free-look period of 30 days from receipt of policy document for new individual policies. Not applicable on renewals or portability/migration.

portability.note: Portability to other insurers allowed as per IRDAI guidelines; apply at least 30 days before renewal.

notable_exclusions.display: Parkinson's/Alzheimer's, sleep apnea, alopecia, hearing aids/spectacles, non-allopathic (base), refractive error <7.5D, STDs (non-HIV), stem cells (non-haematological), RF ablation (unless pre-approved)

optional_riders.display: Maternity+newborn+vaccination, OPD expenses, Hospital Cash, Critical Illness lump sum, Personal Accident (AD+PTD), International Major Illness cover, Waiver of mandatory co-pay, PPN discount, Surrogacy/oocyte complications
